cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

mechanism: A licenses which keepsake may remain while persuading a partner to surrender a signed guitar for a household need.
confusable: Practical budgeting alone would compare prices; A must assume authority over B proposed compromise while addressing sentimental value.
comparison: Private queue memory and household refrigeration differ from a public charity honor exchange.
seedUse: D12-b supplies signature effort and case compromise; S01 controls which part of the attachment B is permitted to keep.
